parts.text: Check the current virtual-stage health. Do not invent an incident when Grafana evidence is healthy.

Investigate incident inc-1042 for volume-a, scene-24, take-07. Identify the affected render node using Grafana metrics and correlated Loki logs, check tracking and network counter-evidence, and recommend but do not execute an action.
Investigate the active synchronization alert, but do not recommend failover if either the critical render metric or correlated log cannot be retrieved.
